fire.rationale: JRPG fire vocabulary is rich and genre-locked: Agi (SMT 30-year anchor), Fira (FF 30-year anchor), Inferno (Ifrit summon), Hellfire (Overlord/Black Clover), Crimson (isekai intensity marker). Two competing canonical vocabularies (SMT proper-nouns vs FF proper-nouns vs English descriptors) give strong cross-source coverage. The isekai track adds crimson as an intensity modifier not present in ARPG.

water.rationale: JRPG ice/water vocabulary is extremely consistent: Blizzara (FF 30-year anchor), Bufu (SMT 30-year anchor), Aqua (KonoSuba character name as element identity), Tide (Leviathan summon), Deluge (Mushoku Tensei/Overlord top-tier). The ice=water mapping is universal across JRPG — cold IS water in genre canon. KonoSuba uniquely makes aqua a proper-noun water word with divine contamination.

earth.rationale: JRPG earth vocabulary yields terra, stone, quake, mineral — less consistent across sources than fire/water. Terra is a proper-noun (FF character) rather than a flavor keyword. Stone/quake are cross-track confirmed. Mineral is niche. JRPG earth lacks the depth of ARPG earth (which has thorn/bedrock/dust) — the element is structurally underserved in JRPG magic systems compared to fire/water/lightning.
earth.expansion_focus_if_recommended: Deeper survey of Mushoku Tensei earth magic vocabulary; Persona earth skills in P3/P4 (Maragi/Mabufula equivalent for earth); Black Clover stone magic

wind.rationale: JRPG wind vocabulary is unusually strong: Garu (SMT 30-year anchor), Aero (FF 30-year anchor), Zephyr (mythology-grounded mid-tier), Squall (FF8 character name), Gale (FFT/Tower of God). Two proper-noun anchors plus three phenomenon descriptors. JRPG wind is better served than ARPG wind (which rated MEDIUM).

lightning.rationale: JRPG lightning vocabulary is very strong: Zio (SMT 30-year anchor), Thundara (FF 30-year anchor), Bolt (FF early entries + Black Clover), Plasma (FF7/Solo Leveling manhwa), Surge (FF13 protagonist-adjacent). Cross-track confirmation with Sampler-A on bolt/surge/plasma. The JRPG track has stronger plasma/surge signal than ARPG.

holy.rationale: JRPG holy vocabulary yields Hama (SMT 30-year anchor), Holy (FF formal element name), Radiance (Black Clover/FF), Aura (FF/Overlord), Seraph (FFT/SMT). The SMT Hama and FF Holy are genre-locked proper-nouns but they name the PRIMARY element, not sub-elements. Aura and seraph are more distinctive as sub-vocabulary. Holy vocabulary in JRPG is structurally dominated by proper-nouns rather than flavor descriptors.
holy.expansion_focus_if_recommended: Survey isekai clerics and paladin-class magic: KonoSuba divine powers, Mushoku Tensei healing magic vocabulary, Overlord divine magic system — focus on non-proper-noun descriptors

shadow.rationale: JRPG/isekai shadow vocabulary is the strongest of any track. Solo Leveling shadow-army framing (shadow, shade) is genre-defining for isekai. Mudo (SMT Chaos/dark anchor), Drain (FF dark mechanic), Void (FF5/Mushoku Tensei), Necro (FF/Overlord), Shadow (Solo Leveling primary element name). Solo Leveling makes shadow the richest isekai element — more candidates discoverable with expansion.
shadow.expansion_focus_if_recommended: Solo Leveling shadow system has more sub-vocabulary (Shadow Exchange, Shadow Preserve, Shadow Linker — individual shadow abilities as sub-vocabulary); Overlord undead vocabulary deeper survey

physical.rationale: 7-vs-8 signal: JRPG/isekai STRONGLY supports physical sub-element treatment. Persona 3 has formal Slash/Strike/Pierce taxonomy with enemy weakness tracking — this is the strongest JRPG precedent for physical-as-layered-element. Additionally: isekai systems (Mushoku Tensei, Slime) distinguish physical impact from elemental damage. The Slash/Strike/Pierce trinity in Persona 3 maps almost exactly to the D&D Bludgeoning/Piercing/Slashing trinity.

substrate_tagging_gaps: Key contamination patterns: (1) aqua contaminates water/holy via KonoSuba water goddess = divine purification framing; (2) hellfire contaminates fire/shadow via infernal framing; (3) squall contaminates wind/water via rain-squall semantic overlap; (4) aura contaminates holy/wind via aura-as-emanation. The JRPG proper-noun vocabulary (Agi, Bufu, Zio, Garu, Hama, Mudo) is entirely contamination-free — it is element-locked by design. The biggest gap is earth: JRPG earth vocabulary is thin compared to fire/water/wind/lightning.
seven_vs_eight_signal: JRPG/isekai STRONGLY supports 8-element (physical-as-sub-element-layered) treatment. The Persona 3 Slash/Strike/Pierce formal taxonomy is the strongest genre evidence found across all three tracks for treating physical as a sub-layered element with distinct mechanical vocabulary. Persona 3 tracks enemy weaknesses to Slash, Strike, and Pierce separately — exactly the same mechanical structure as tracking weaknesses to Fire, Ice, Lightning, Wind. This is the most direct counterargument to the 7-element (physical flat-primary) model. Additionally, Mushoku Tensei and Slime isekai both distinguish physical impact from elemental damage in their magic systems. JRPG vote: STRONG for 8-element treatment.
track_alignment_concerns: Alignment: JRPG proper-noun vocabulary (Agi/Bufu/Zio/Garu/Hama/Mudo) is genre-locked but NOT player-facing recognizable for non-JRPG players. Reincarnated isekai positioning means JRPG players are the target audience — but proper-nouns as sub-element flavor vocabulary would be opaque to ARPG-only players. Recommend proper-noun row_ids be flagged as JRPG-recognizable but cross-track-unconfirmed. Constraint: holy vocabulary (Hama, Holy) primarily names the PRIMARY element rather than sub-elements — this is a structural JRPG limitation for the holy gap-fill objective. Shadow vocabulary (Mudo, Void, Drain) is stronger.
sampler_summary: JRPG/isekai track yields strong coverage for fire (5 rows; two 30-year locked FF/SMT anchors plus isekai intensity markers), water (5 rows; ice=water canonical mapping; aqua as KonoSuba divine-water unique find), wind (5 rows; strongest JRPG track — garu/aero as 30-year anchors), lightning (5 rows; zio/thundara anchors plus plasma/surge), shadow (6 rows; Solo Leveling shadow-army vocabulary is the highlight; recommend expansion). Earth (4 rows) and holy (5 rows with proper-noun dominance) are the weaker yields. Physical: STRONG 7-vs-8 signal — Persona 3 Slash/Strike/Pierce formal taxonomy is the strongest genre evidence for 8-element treatment found in this research. Total: 40 rows. Sources most load-bearing: Persona/SMT, Final Fantasy, Solo Leveling, Overlord.
